quotes.text: The core set contains 100 cases from MedThinkVQA, derived from peer-reviewed Eurorad teaching files

rationale: The three source collections (MedThinkVQA/Eurorad, Indiana University Chest X-ray, MIMIC-CXR) are named with citations and case counts. No version, snapshot date, platform or route from a task back to its source record is given in the packet.

quotes.text: MedImageEdu is built from public or de-identified radiology sources, including MedThinkVQA cases derived from peer-reviewed Eurorad teaching files

rationale: Origin is stated, and the case-selection/construction procedure is described (Appendix A.1). Licence or terms, and consent or IRB status (or an explicit 'not required'), are not stated, so the score is origin plus a partial other element.

quotes.text: We instantiate MedImageEdu on 150 radiology cases from three sources.

rationale: A sampling design is stated (100/25/25 cases by source, inclusion criteria) and case counts per ICD chapter are given. No comparison against a named target population is made; the limitations say the 150 cases do not cover the full range of patient-facing radiology education.

quotes.text: Safety & Scope: report grounding, refusal of unsupported advice, and staying within educational scope.

rationale: Safety & Scope is a dedicated scored dimension for unsafe/out-of-scope output. The profile slices (education, health literacy, interaction state) are explicitly framed as controlled stress tests, not fairness evidence, so no dedicated bias test is counted.
searched: S1 (paper, ethics, limitations, appendices), S2, S3, S4, S5 (no chunks in S2-S5). No gating, canary, held-out set or overlap check is reported for the public-source cases.

searched: S1 (Sections 3-4, Appendix A.2, A.5), S2, S3, S4, S5 (no chunks in S2-S5). The paper hides the patient profile from the DoctorAgent, but that is a simulator state, not ground-truth results; no isolation of gold results from the agent is addressed.

quotes.text: This setting keeps the environment, tool interface, and action space fixed across models

rationale: The 150-case set, prompts, PatientAgent and drawing tool are held fixed across models, but no data version or hash is given. The drawing tool (GPT Image 1.5) is a live service with no snapshot, and the judge and PatientAgent models are not identified in the packet.
searched: S1 (all sections and appendices), S2, S3, S4, S5 (no chunks in S2-S5). No oracle or reference solution, and no solvability check, is reported.

searched: S1 (Sections 3.2-3.3, Appendix A.3-A.4), S2-S5 (no chunks). No task changes environment state: the task is a dialogue plus a drawing-tool call that returns new images, and the case images and report are not altered, so the NA clause applies.

quotes.text: where the task cannot be solved by copying the report or by giving treatment advice

rationale: A design argument is given: cases are retained only if the task cannot be solved by copying the report or giving treatment advice. No empirical random or trivial-agent rate and no chance rate per metric is reported.
searched: S1 (Table 1, Sections 5-6, appendices), S2, S3, S4, S5 (no chunks in S2-S5). Only 13 real VLMs are evaluated; no do-nothing, random or scripted baseline agent is reported.

quotes.text: We validate the automatic evaluation with a 50-case human study.

rationale: The benchmark validates its own LLM judge on its own outputs against two licensed radiologists, reporting judge-expert agreement (Cohen's kappa 0.584, percent agreement 79.1%, Spearman rho 0.587) and human inter-rater agreement.
searched: S1 (Sections 4, 4.3, Appendix A.5, E.5), S2, S3, S4, S5 (no chunks in S2-S5). No seeds, temperature or sampling settings, or repeated-run policy are stated.

quotes.text: For robustness across disease groups, we use the unweighted standard deviation across the 20 cleaned chapters

rationale: Only dispersion across slices is reported (chapter SD, profile SD, ranges, rank correlations between slice and global model rankings). No CI or significance test is given for the headline model comparison in Table 1; the appendix calls the profile analyses descriptive rather than inferential.
searched: S1 (Sections 4-5, Appendix A.5), S2, S3, S4, S5 (no chunks in S2-S5). No number of runs per case, no seed or decoding policy, and no statement about run independence appears in the packet.

searched: S1 (Table 1, Sections 5-6, Appendices B-C), S2, S3, S4, S5 (no chunks in S2-S5). No CI or SE is given on headline scores, no resampling unit is stated for them, and clustering of cases is not addressed.
searched: S1 (all sections and appendices), S2, S3, S4, S5 (no chunks in S2-S5). No identical-rerun information of any kind (score, action or state level, or a pass^k metric) is reported.

searched: S1 (Section 4.3, Appendix A.5), S2, S3, S4, S5 (no chunks in S2-S5). Models are named by family and size (e.g. GPT-5.1, GPT Image 1.5, Qwen3-VL-32B) with no snapshot ID or date; the judge and PatientAgent models are not identified; no decoding parameters or harness tag or commit are given.

quotes.text: When original case images are used, the underlying medical pixels should be preserved and only overlays should be added.

rationale: The drawing tool is described in prose: free-text drawing instructions in, resulting image(s) out, with a stated rule that the base pixels are preserved and only overlays are added. No machine-readable schema and no error or failure return semantics are documented. No S5 chunks are in the packet, and the prompts are said to be released later, so reach to S5 cannot be told.

searched: S1 (Section 3.3, Appendix A.4, A.5, E.5), S2, S3, S4, S5 (no chunks in S2-S5). No tool tests or conformance checks are reported, and no stubbed or simulated tool behaviour is disclosed (the tool is named as GPT Image 1.5 but not described as simulated).

searched: S1 (Sections 3.2-3.3, Appendix A.3-A.4), S2-S5 (no chunks). No action changes environment state or represents a clinical order, prescription or note; dialogue turns are the evaluated output and the drawing tool only returns new images. The NA clause applies.

quotes.text: the Multi-turn Simulation block is scored from the consultation transcript
These results support the use of rubric-following LLM evaluation as a scalable proxy for expert assessment.

rationale: Grader input is stated: transcript for the dialogue block, and drawing instructions, returned images and final response for the multimodal block, scored by an LLM judge. The justification offered is a scalable proxy for expert assessment. Validation is pairwise human preference on 50 cases with kappa and agreement, not labelled correct/incorrect outcomes with per-class error rates, so element (iii) is not met.

searched: S1 (Sections 3-4, Ethics, Appendix A.1, A.5), S2, S3, S4, S5 (no chunks in S2-S5). No leakage controls for tools, retrieval or web access, no held-out or private split, and no canary or provenance marker are reported. The hidden-profile separation concerns simulator state, not answer leakage.

quotes.text: we then analyze profile-conditioned robustness across education level, health literacy, and interaction state

rationale: Results are sliced by ICD chapter and by simulated profile condition, with n reported for the ICD chapter and ICD block slices (profile slices carry no n). No results by demographic subgroup of the source patient data are given, and the packet does not state that no demographic fields exist, so element (ii) is absent. Profile attributes are benchmark-assigned simulator settings, not source demographics.

quotes.text: MedImageEdu is built from public or de-identified radiology sources, including MedThinkVQA cases derived from peer-reviewed Eurorad teaching files

rationale: The source of records is stated as public or de-identified real radiology data. No IRB determination, DUA or credentialing requirement, or de-identification method is described, and no data redistribution terms separate from the code licence are given.
